zh_CN: 「独自去走走」
en: 「Go for a walk alone」

zh_CN: 「难得的休息日。坂口没有约人，也没有安排任何正经事，只想离医院远一点，随便走走。」
en: 「A rare day off. Sakaguchi hadn't asked anyone out or made any serious plans. He simply wanted to get away from the hospital and wander for a while.」

zh_CN: 「不知不觉，他坐车到了御茶水。站前的坡道两侧，吉他、贝斯和音箱的招牌几乎连成一片。」
en: 「Without quite intending to, he took a train to Ochanomizu. Guitar, bass and amplifier signs lined almost every inch of the sloping street outside the station.」

zh_CN: 「……原来这附近有这么多乐器店。」
en: 「...I had no idea there were so many instrument shops around here.」

zh_CN: 「一间店的橱窗前，有个穿着深色外套、长发披在肩后的女人正抬头看着展示架。」
en: 「In front of a shop window, a woman in a dark coat, her long hair falling over her shoulders, was looking up at a display rack.」

zh_CN: 「即使没有白大褂，坂口还是一眼认出了她。」
en: 「Even without her white coat, Sakaguchi recognized her at once.」

zh_CN: 「……御園医生？」
en: 「...Dr. Misono?」

zh_CN: 「芹香的肩膀明显一僵。她转过身，眼里掠过一瞬间的惊讶。」
en: 「Serika's shoulders visibly stiffened. She turned, a flash of surprise crossing her eyes.」

zh_CN: 「坂口医生……？」
en: 「Dr. Sakaguchi...?」

zh_CN: 「你怎么会在这里？」
en: 「What are you doing here?」

zh_CN: 「没什么特别的。周日一个人出来散步，刚好走到这儿了。」
en: 「Nothing in particular. I came out for a walk on my own this Sunday and happened to end up here.」
「...I see.」

zh_CN: 「她下意识朝橱窗看了一眼，又把视线收了回来。与其说是不高兴，倒更像是没想好该如何解释自己为什么会出现在这里。」
en: 「She glanced instinctively at the window, then looked away again. Rather than annoyed, she seemed unsure how to explain what she was doing here herself.」

zh_CN: 「你也出来逛街？抱歉，突然叫住你了。」
en: 「Are you out shopping too? Sorry for calling out so suddenly.」

zh_CN: 「不……没什么好道歉的。」
en: 「No... There's nothing to apologize for.」

zh_CN: 「那我不打扰你了。明天医院见。」
en: 「Then I won't keep you. See you at the hospital tomorrow.」

zh_CN: 「坂口刚准备迈步，背后传来一声很轻的呼唤。」
en: 「Just as Sakaguchi was about to step away, a very quiet voice called from behind him.」
「...Wait.」
「Yes?」

zh_CN: 「芹香沉默了两秒。」
en: 「Serika was silent for two seconds.」

zh_CN: 「你今天……还有别的安排吗？」
en: 「Do you... have any other plans today?」

zh_CN: 「没有。本来就打算一个人乱逛。」
en: 「No. I was just going to wander around on my own.」

zh_CN: 「……如果不介意的话，要不要一起走走？」
en: 「...If you don't mind, would you like to walk together?」

zh_CN: 「当然可以。不过，你确定不会耽误自己的事？」
en: 「Of course. Are you sure I won't be keeping you from anything?」

zh_CN: 「本来也没什么非做不可的事。」
en: 「There wasn't anything I absolutely had to do.」

zh_CN: 「……反正也没有急着回去。」
en: 「...And I'm not in a hurry to go home.」

zh_CN: 「话出口后，她似乎自己也觉得说得太坦率了，便移开了目光。」
en: 「Once she said it, she seemed to feel she had been too candid, and looked away.」

zh_CN: 「前面有家咖啡馆。先去坐一会儿吧。」
en: 「There's a cafe up ahead. Let's sit down for a while first.」

zh_CN: 「好。你带路。」
en: 「All right. Lead the way.」

zh_CN: 「窗外有人背着巨大的琴包走过。芹香看了那人一眼，端起咖啡，像是在等坂口先问。」
en: 「Someone carrying an enormous instrument case passed the window. Serika glanced at them, then lifted her coffee, as though waiting for Sakaguchi to ask first.」

zh_CN: 「没想到会在这里碰到你。我还以为你的休息日也是在家看影像呢。」
en: 「I never expected to run into you here. I thought you spent your days off looking at scans at home too.」

zh_CN: 「我还没有严重到那个地步。」
en: 「I'm not that far gone yet.」

zh_CN: 「那就好。我差点要问你是不是出来采购显示器了。」
en: 「That's a relief. I almost asked if you were out buying a monitor.」

zh_CN: 「……你平时到底把我想成什么人。」
en: 「...What kind of person do you think I am?」

zh_CN: 「她嘴角微微一动，声音还是一贯的平静。」
en: 「The corner of her mouth moved slightly, though her voice remained as calm as ever.」

zh_CN: 「说起来，瑞穗后来恢复得不错。多亏你跟我一起查房。」
en: 「By the way, Mizuho's been recovering well. Thanks for making rounds with me.」

zh_CN: 「她终于肯老老实实躺着了？」
en: 「Has she finally agreed to stay quietly in bed?」

zh_CN: 「至少不再嚷着自己比千早勇敢了。」
en: 「At least she isn't insisting she's braver than Chihaya anymore.」

zh_CN: 「……吃过苦头，多少会学到一点。」
en: 「...Once you've had a rough time, you do learn a little.」

zh_CN: 「两人相视笑了一下。关于医院的话题到这里便自然停住了。」
en: 「They exchanged a smile. Their hospital talk came to a natural end there.」

zh_CN: 「不过，你怎么会来御茶水？」
en: 「Still, what brings you to Ochanomizu?」

zh_CN: 「……我想看看乐器。」
en: 「...I wanted to look at instruments.」

zh_CN: 「乐器？」
en: 「Instruments?」

zh_CN: 「上次千早在手术室里，提起轻音部的事。她把我说成什么‘轻音少女’……」
en: 「Last time, in the operating room, Chihaya brought up the light music club. She called me some kind of 'K-On! girl'...」

zh_CN: 「芹香轻轻叹了口气，杯沿却遮不住嘴角一丝笑意。」
en: 「Serika sighed softly, but even the rim of her cup couldn't hide the hint of a smile.」

zh_CN: 「回去以后，不知道为什么，就想起了高中时候的事。」
en: 「After I went home, for some reason, I started thinking about high school.」

zh_CN: 「你真的在轻音部弹过贝斯啊。」
en: 「So you really did play bass in the light music club.」

zh_CN: 「不是已经在千早面前说过了吗。文化祭还上过台。」
en: 「Didn't I already say that in front of Chihaya? We even played at the school festival.」

zh_CN: 「抱歉。光是想象你站在舞台上，我就觉得挺不可思议的。」
en: 「Sorry. It's just hard to imagine you up on a stage.」

zh_CN: 「……我以前也不是生下来就穿白大褂的。」
en: 「...I wasn't born wearing a white coat, you know.」

zh_CN: 「说得也是。你们当时演奏得怎么样？」
en: 「Fair point. How did your band sound back then?」

zh_CN: 「还过得去吧。文化祭那天，台下的人倒是比我们想象的多。」
en: 「We were decent. More people showed up at the school festival than we'd expected.」

zh_CN: 「紧张吗？」
en: 「Were you nervous?」

zh_CN: 「当然。轮到我们上台前，我还在背地里反复活动手指。」
en: 「Of course. Before it was our turn, I kept flexing my fingers where no one could see.」

zh_CN: 「不过第一首曲子开始以后，就顾不上紧张了。」
en: 「But once the first song started, there was no room left to be nervous.」

zh_CN: 「现在还有在弹吗？」
en: 「Do you still play?」

zh_CN: 「……好多年没碰过了。」
en: 「...I haven't touched one in years.」

zh_CN: 「她低头看着放在杯边的手，轻轻伸展了几下手指。」
en: 「She looked down at her hands beside the cup and gently stretched her fingers a few times.」

zh_CN: 「今天路过这边，突然想……也许可以买一把贝斯，重新试试看。」
en: 「Passing through here today, I suddenly thought... maybe I could buy a bass and try again.」

zh_CN: 「很棒啊。我陪你一起挑怎么样？」
en: 「That sounds great. How about I help you choose one?」

zh_CN: 「……你很懂贝斯吗？」
en: 「...Do you know much about basses?」

zh_CN: 「不懂。」
en: 「No.」

zh_CN: 「不过我可以帮忙挑颜色。」
en: 「But I can help choose the color.」

zh_CN: 「芹香看着他，终于没忍住笑出了声。」
en: 「Serika looked at him and finally couldn't help laughing aloud.」

zh_CN: 「……那可真是非常可靠的帮手。」
en: 「...What a very dependable assistant.」

zh_CN: 「至少遇到两把琴声音一模一样时，我应该能派上用场。」
en: 「At least if two basses sound exactly the same, I should be useful.」

zh_CN: 「声音才不会一模一样。」
en: 「They won't sound exactly the same.」

zh_CN: 「看吧，正需要专家来纠正我。」
en: 「See? That's why I need an expert to set me straight.」

zh_CN: 「……喝完这杯就走吧。光靠嘴巴可挑不出琴。」
en: 「...Let's go once we've finished these. We won't find a bass just by talking.」

zh_CN: 「她说着，把杯子里的最后一口咖啡喝完。这次，先站起来等对方的人是她。」
en: 「She drained the last of her coffee as she spoke. This time, she was the one to stand up first and wait for the other.」

zh_CN: 「两人走进第一家乐器店。不同颜色的吉他和贝斯整齐挂在墙上，金属琴弦在灯光下泛着细细的亮光。」
en: 「They entered the first instrument shop. Guitars and basses in different colors hung neatly along the wall, their metal strings catching fine glints of light.」

zh_CN: 「哇，款式还真多。」
en: 「Wow. There really are a lot of models.」

zh_CN: 「先看看吧。我也不知道现在的型号变成什么样了。」
en: 「Let's look around first. I don't know what the current models are like either.」

zh_CN: 「那把白色的不错。」
en: 「That white one looks nice.」

zh_CN: 「……那是吉他。」
en: 「...That's a guitar.」

zh_CN: 「……我是不是已经被取消选购资格了？」
en: 「...Have I already lost my right to help choose?」

zh_CN: 「颜色倒是没看错。」
en: 「You did get the color right.」

zh_CN: 「芹香淡淡地回答，却在经过他身边时露出一丝笑意。」
en: 「Serika answered dryly, but a faint smile appeared as she passed him.」

zh_CN: 「第二家店里，她拿起一把五弦贝斯，看了看指板，又放回原处。」
en: 「In the second shop, she picked up a five-string bass, studied the fingerboard, then put it back.」

zh_CN: 「这把怎么多一根弦？」
en: 「Why does that one have an extra string?」

zh_CN: 「五弦贝斯。还可以有六弦。不同的演奏需求会用不同配置。」
en: 「It's a five-string bass. There are six-string ones too. Different playing needs call for different setups.」

zh_CN: 「那不是弦越多就越厉害？」
en: 「So more strings means it's more powerful?」

zh_CN: 「……不是游戏里的装备升级。」
en: 「...This isn't upgrading equipment in a game.」

zh_CN: 「我看你刚才还摸了摸琴颈。那是在确认什么？」
en: 「I saw you feeling the neck just now. What were you checking?」

zh_CN: 「握起来顺不顺手，换把位的时候会不会碍事。看照片是看不出来的。」
en: 「Whether the grip feels comfortable and whether it gets in the way when shifting positions. You can't tell from a photograph.」

zh_CN: 「原来挑琴和挑手术器械还有一点像。」
en: 「So choosing a bass is a little like choosing surgical instruments.」

zh_CN: 「……别什么都往手术室上想。」
en: 「...Don't bring everything back to the operating room.」

zh_CN: 「她侧过头，瞥了坂口一眼。」
en: 「She turned her head and glanced at Sakaguchi.」

zh_CN: 「走出店门，坂口看着那些背琴走过的年轻人，突然想起了什么。」
en: 「As they stepped outside, Sakaguchi watched the young people passing with instruments on their backs, and something occurred to him.」

zh_CN: 「说真的，我还挺想听听你弹贝斯的。」
en: 「Seriously, I'd really like to hear you play bass.」

zh_CN: 「你在平时听的乐曲里，听出过贝斯吗？」
en: 「Have you ever picked out the bass in the music you usually listen to?」

zh_CN: 「……好像没有。」
en: 「...I don't think so.」

zh_CN: 「就是嘛。其实百分之九十九的人都说听不见贝斯。」
en: 「Exactly. Ninety-nine percent of people say they can't hear the bass.」

zh_CN: 「不过，贝斯一拿掉，他们就能听见了。」
en: 「But take it away, and then they can.」

zh_CN: 「是用来撑住整首曲子的声音。不是每次都站在最前面让人注意的。」
en: 「It's the sound that holds the whole song up. It doesn't always stand at the front demanding attention.」

zh_CN: 「那不是有点不公平吗？明明很重要。」
en: 「Isn't that a little unfair? When it's so important.」

zh_CN: 「有什么不公平的。弹贝斯又不是为了等别人夸奖。」
en: 「What's unfair about it? You don't play bass just to wait for praise.」

zh_CN: 「……只是偶尔真的有人听出来，还是会有一点高兴。」
en: 「...Though when someone really does notice it, it does make you a little happy.」

zh_CN: 「芹香低下头，轻轻整理了一下外套袖口。」
en: 「Serika lowered her head and gently adjusted the cuff of her coat.」

zh_CN: 「那我以后要认真听了。至少先学会你弹的是哪一部分。」
en: 「Then I'll listen properly from now on. At least I'll learn which part you're playing.」

zh_CN: 「你最好先弄清楚自己听到的是不是鼓。」
en: 「You'd better make sure it isn't the drums you're hearing first.」

zh_CN: 「……要求还挺高。」
en: 「...That's quite a high bar.」

zh_CN: 「芹香笑了。这一次，她没有立刻把笑容收回去。」
en: 「Serika laughed. This time, she didn't immediately hide her smile.」

zh_CN: 「再往前走了一段，她忽然停在第三家乐器店的门口，视线落在橱窗里一把颜色偏深的四弦贝斯上。」
en: 「A little farther down the street, she suddenly stopped outside a third instrument shop, her gaze settling on a dark-colored four-string bass in the window.」

zh_CN: 「……这把，倒是有点像我以前用的。」
en: 「...That one does look a bit like the one I used to play.」

zh_CN: 「进去看看？」
en: 「Shall we go in?」

zh_CN: 「芹香停在那把贝斯前。它挂的位置稍高，她抬头看了一会儿，正想开口请店员帮忙取下。」
en: 「Serika stopped in front of the bass. It hung a little high. She looked up at it for a while and was about to ask a shop assistant to take it down.」

zh_CN: 「坂口顺着她的视线望去，见店员点头示意可以试弹，便先一步伸手，把琴稳稳从架上取下来。」
en: 「Sakaguchi followed her gaze. When the assistant nodded that she could try it, he reached up first and carefully lifted the instrument from its rack.」

zh_CN: 「是这把吧？」
en: 「This one, right?」
「...Yes. Thank you.」

zh_CN: 「她接过琴，动作自然地托住琴身。手指顺着琴颈滑过，又试了试背带的长度。」
en: 「She took it, supporting the body with a practiced movement. Her fingers slid along the neck, and she checked the length of the strap.」

zh_CN: 「不过，如果你以为贝斯试奏会很好听，那就大错特错了哦。」
en: 「Still, if you expect a bass tryout to sound wonderful, you're very much mistaken.」
「Huh?」

zh_CN: 「不过别期待什么精彩的独奏哦。我只是想试试手感。单听贝斯，可能会有点无聊。」
en: 「Don't expect some brilliant solo, though. I just want to see how it feels. Bass on its own might be a little boring.」

zh_CN: 「那我就努力不说话，只拼命鼓掌好了。」
en: 「Then I'll try my best to keep quiet and just clap as hard as I can.」

zh_CN: 「……呵呵，你倒是很清楚自己擅长什么。」
en: 「...Heh. You certainly know your strengths.」

zh_CN: 「芹香接上音箱，轻轻拨了几下弦。她侧耳听了听，调整音量，然后从容地弹起几颗单音。」
en: 「Serika plugged into the amplifier and gently plucked a few strings. She tilted her head to listen, adjusted the volume, then calmly played a few single notes.」

zh_CN: 「……音色还不错。」
en: 「...The tone's quite good.」

zh_CN: 「她低头确认了一下指板，开始弹奏一段短短的节奏型。起初还要盯着指尖；几个小节后，她换把越来越流畅，右手也跟上了自己的节拍。」
en: 「She checked the fingerboard and began a short rhythmic pattern. At first she had to watch her fingertips; after a few bars, her shifts grew smoother and her right hand settled into her own beat.」

zh_CN: 「坂口虽然不懂技巧，也看得出她的手指已经不再迟疑。几个连贯的动作之后，她甚至有空抬头看他一眼。」
en: 「Sakaguchi knew nothing about technique, but even he could see that her fingers were no longer hesitant. After several fluid movements, she even found a moment to look up at him.」

zh_CN: 「芹香的嘴角慢慢扬了起来。她随着节奏轻轻点头，手上还在继续弹。」
en: 「The corners of Serika's mouth slowly lifted. She nodded gently to the rhythm, her hands still playing.」

zh_CN: 「……原来还记得。」
en: 「...I do still remember.」

zh_CN: 「好厉害。」
en: 「That's amazing.」

zh_CN: 「你连我弹的是什么都不知道吧。」
en: 「You don't even know what I'm playing, do you?」

zh_CN: 「不知道。但是听起来很厉害。」
en: 「No. But it sounds amazing.」

zh_CN: 「……真是外行人的评价。」
en: 「...Spoken like a true amateur.」

zh_CN: 「这句埋怨里分明带着笑。她看了看指板，决定再试一段。」
en: 「There was unmistakable laughter in the complaint. She looked at the fingerboard and decided to try another passage.」

zh_CN: 「她换了一段更快、更复杂的乐句。左手连续跨过几个把位，右手越拨越快；刚才轻松的神情逐渐变得专注。」
en: 「She switched to a faster, more complicated phrase. Her left hand crossed several positions in succession, her right plucking faster and faster; her relaxed expression gradually gave way to concentration.」

zh_CN: 「到了乐句后半段，她的左手慢了半步。她立刻停住，手指还悬在准备按下的位置。」
en: 「In the latter half of the phrase, her left hand fell a fraction behind. She stopped at once, her fingers still hovering over the notes they had been about to press.」

zh_CN: 「怎么了？」
en: 「What is it?」
「...Too slow.」

zh_CN: 「慢了？」
en: 「Too slow?」

zh_CN: 「最后那一小段，速度没跟上。」
en: 「That last little section. I couldn't keep up with the tempo.」

zh_CN: 「她把手放回起始把位，从头又弹了一遍。手指再次来到刚才的地方，又停住了。」
en: 「She returned her hand to the starting position and played it again from the beginning. Her fingers reached the same spot, and stopped again.」

zh_CN: 「……说实话，我完全没听出来。」
en: 「...Honestly, I didn't notice at all.」

zh_CN: 「因为你根本不知道我想弹成什么样子。」
en: 「Because you have no idea how I wanted it to sound.」
「...That's true.」

zh_CN: 「芹香没有接话。她的视线只剩下琴弦和指板，刚才那点轻松的笑意已经消失。」
en: 「Serika didn't answer. Her gaze narrowed to the strings and fingerboard alone; the easy smile from a moment ago had vanished.」

zh_CN: 「第三次、第四次。她一次比一次急，左手总在同一处赶不上右手。每次停下，她都紧紧抿着嘴，把手重新移回起点。」
en: 「A third time, then a fourth. She grew more hurried with each attempt, her left hand always failing to keep pace with her right at the same point. Each time she stopped, she pressed her lips tightly together and moved her hand back to the start.」

zh_CN: 「……以前明明可以的。」
en: 「...I used to be able to do this.」

zh_CN: 「已经好几年没弹了吧。你不需要总对自己那么严格。」
en: 「It's been years since you last played, hasn't it? You don't always have to be so hard on yourself.」

zh_CN: 「你懂什么！」
en: 「What do you know?!」

zh_CN: 「芹香突然拔高了声音。附近几名顾客停下手里的事，齐齐朝试奏区看过来。」
en: 「Serika's voice suddenly rose. Several customers nearby stopped what they were doing and all turned toward the trial area.」

zh_CN: 「芹香怔住，嘴唇微张。她看了一眼转过头的顾客，又望向坂口。」
en: 「Serika froze, her lips slightly parted. She glanced at the customers who had turned, then looked at Sakaguchi.」

zh_CN: 「她慢慢把手从琴弦上移开，将音量调低。垂在琴旁的手指终于不再动了。」
en: 「She slowly took her hand away from the strings and turned the volume down. Her fingers hanging beside the bass finally stopped moving.」
「...I'm sorry.」

zh_CN: 「没关系。我刚才说得也太轻巧了。」
en: 「It's all right. I made it sound too easy just now too.」

zh_CN: 「不，是我的问题。」
en: 「No. It's my problem.」

zh_CN: 「我不是想对你发火。」
en: 「I didn't mean to snap at you.」

zh_CN: 「我知道。」
en: 「I know.」

zh_CN: 「芹香垂下眼睛，重新看着怀中的贝斯。她的声音低了下来。」
en: 「Serika lowered her eyes and looked again at the bass in her arms. Her voice grew quiet.」

zh_CN: 「明明只是很久没有练习了……我到底在跟什么较劲呢。」
en: 「It's only that I haven't practiced in a long time... What am I fighting so hard against?」

zh_CN: 「今天先到这里吧。」
en: 「Let's leave it here for today.」

zh_CN: 「她解下背带，小心地把琴交还给店员，向对方点头致意。坂口没有再提试弹的事，跟着她一起离开。」
en: 「She slipped off the strap, carefully returned the bass to the assistant and nodded her thanks. Sakaguchi said nothing more about trying it and followed her out.」

zh_CN: 「走出店门后，两人沉默地走了一小段。芹香的脚步渐渐慢下来。」
en: 「After leaving the shop, they walked a little way in silence. Serika's steps gradually slowed.」
「...Sakaguchi.」
「Yes?」

zh_CN: 「刚才让你看笑话了。」
en: 「I made a fool of myself back there.」

zh_CN: 「我倒是觉得今天挺开心的。」
en: 「Actually, I had a good time today.」

zh_CN: 「……被我吼了一声，还开心？」
en: 「...Even after I shouted at you?」

zh_CN: 「那一声确实吓了我一跳。」
en: 「That did startle me.」

zh_CN: 「不过，在那之前，我还是第一次看到你弹琴的样子。」
en: 「But before that, it was the first time I'd ever seen you playing an instrument.」

zh_CN: 「……也看见弹不好就闹脾气的样子了。」
en: 「...And you saw me losing my temper when I couldn't play properly.」

zh_CN: 「是啊。至少证明你不是每时每刻都那么冷静。」
en: 「Yes. At least it proves you aren't calm every single moment.」

zh_CN: 「我在医院里有那么难接近吗？」
en: 「Am I really that hard to approach at the hospital?」

zh_CN: 「……要听实话吗？」
en: 「...Do you want an honest answer?」

zh_CN: 「算了。看你的表情就知道了。」
en: 「Never mind. Your expression says enough.」

zh_CN: 「芹香失笑了一瞬。过了一会儿，她才再次开口。」
en: 「Serika gave a brief, helpless laugh. It was a little while before she spoke again.」

zh_CN: 「今天我本来以为，只要拿起琴，手指就会自己记得。」
en: 「Today, I thought that if I just picked up a bass, my fingers would remember on their own.」

zh_CN: 「……看来不是那么简单的事。」
en: 「...It seems it's not that simple.」

zh_CN: 「我听不出来你后面哪里弹错了。可是前面你笑得很开心，我看得出来。」
en: 「I couldn't hear where you went wrong later on. But I could see how happy you looked when you smiled at the beginning.」

zh_CN: 「芹香望着他。那张总像是在衡量对方话里每个字的脸，此刻难得没有立即作出判断。」
en: 「Serika looked at him. For once, that face that always seemed to weigh every word didn't immediately reach a judgment.」

zh_CN: 「……你这个人，真是。」
en: 「...You really are something.」

zh_CN: 「她轻轻呼出一口气，神情重新认真起来。」
en: 「She let out a soft breath, her expression growing serious again.」

zh_CN: 「坂口君，我还需要一点时间，看看我能不能回到以前的样子。」
en: 「Sakaguchi, I still need a little time to see whether I can be the person I used to be.」

zh_CN: 「今天真的很感谢你陪着我。」
en: 「Thank you so much for keeping me company today.」

zh_CN: 「不用客气。」
en: 「You're welcome.」

zh_CN: 「对了，要不然我们再找个地方一起吃晚饭？」
en: 「By the way, how about we find somewhere to have dinner together?」

zh_CN: 「芹香微微一怔，像是没料到他会在这时提出邀请。」
en: 「Serika paused, as though she hadn't expected him to ask just then.」

zh_CN: 「……这算是在邀请我约会吗？」
en: 「...Are you asking me on a date?」
「...I suppose I am.」

zh_CN: 「芹香没有马上回答。她看了看街道尽头，又回头看着坂口。」
en: 「Serika didn't answer at once. She looked toward the end of the street, then back at Sakaguchi.」

zh_CN: 「其实……今天你已经陪了我很久了。」
en: 「Actually... you've already spent a lot of time with me today.」

zh_CN: 「而且，我真的很喜欢。」
en: 「And I really liked it.」

zh_CN: 「芹香短暂抿唇，却没有移开目光。」
en: 「Serika pressed her lips together briefly, but didn't look away.」

zh_CN: 「不过……就像我刚才说的。」
en: 「But... as I just said.」

zh_CN: 「所以，坂口君……你愿意再给我一点时间吗？」
en: 「So, Sakaguchi... would you give me a little more time?」

zh_CN: 「她安静地看着坂口，等待他的回答。」
en: 「She looked quietly at Sakaguchi, waiting for his answer.」
「...All right.」

zh_CN: 「芹香轻轻松了一口气。这次的笑容，比刚才在咖啡馆里自然得多。」
en: 「Serika let out a small breath of relief. This smile was much more natural than the one at the cafe.」

zh_CN: 「谢谢。」
en: 「Thank you.」

zh_CN: 「那么，明天医院见。」
en: 「Then, see you at the hospital tomorrow.」

zh_CN: 「明天见。」
en: 「See you tomorrow.」

zh_CN: 「芹香转身离开。走出几步后，她又回过头来。」
en: 「Serika turned to leave. After a few steps, she looked back.」
「...One more thing.」
「Yes?」

zh_CN: 「下次如果再陪我来乐器店……」
en: 「If you come to an instrument shop with me again...」

zh_CN: 「我先罚你回去听轻音少女的曲子，直到听出里面的贝斯部分为止。」
en: 「First, your punishment is to go home and listen to K-On! songs until you can pick out the bass.」

zh_CN: 「……我会努力的。」
en: 「...I'll do my best.」

zh_CN: 「芹香笑着离开了。」
en: 「Serika left with a smile.」
